# 2 Baruch Chapter 65 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 65:1 — Josiah's triple achievement

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "who-restored-the-passover, and-who-renewed-the-covenant, and-who-built-the-temple" |
| LOGOS | "who restored the Passover, and who renewed the covenant of the Lord, and who built the temple of God in a great way" |
| PNEUMA | "who restored the Passover, renewed the covenant of the Lord, and greatly rebuilt God's temple" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. The Syriac tricolon preserves three distinct achievements with syntactic parallelism; LOGOS maintains the parallelism more precisely than PNEUMA's compression.
